Which parent companies cover the most Medicaid managed care enrollees?
Medicaid Managed Care Enrollment By Program And Plan

SELECT parent_organization, sum(try_cast(total_enrollment AS double)) AS enrollees FROM govblock_health.medicaid_managed_care_enrollment_by_program_and_plan WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2017' AND parent_organization <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many PubMed papers are indexed under hemoglobins?
SELECT count(DISTINCT pmid) AS papers FROM govblock_health.pubmed_mesh WHERE descriptor_name = 'Hemoglobins'
Which states have the most nuclear event reports?
SELECT state, count(*) AS events FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_event_notifications WHERE state <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How long does a recorded oral argument last on average, in minutes?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(duration AS double)) / 60, 1) AS minutes FROM govblock_courts.oral_arguments
Which companies have received the most recorded patent assignments?
SELECT ee_name, count(*) AS assignments FROM govblock_patents.assign_assignee GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average return on assets across FDIC-insured banks at the end of 2023?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(roa AS double)), 2) AS average_roa FROM govblock_finance.fdic_financials WHERE cast(repdte AS varchar) = '20231231'
Which stable materials in the Materials Project have the widest band gaps?
SELECT formula_pretty, try_cast(band_gap AS double) AS band_gap_ev FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary WHERE try_cast(energy_above_hull AS double) = 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many trademark applications were filed in each of the last ten years?
SELECT substr(cast(filing_dt AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS applications FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE filing_dt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
Congressional campaigns in which states spent the most in 2010?
SELECT can_off_sta, sum(try_cast(dis_amo AS double)) AS spent FROM govblock_fec.candidate_disbursement WHERE ele_yea = '2010' AND can_off_sta IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did Pfizer pay doctors and teaching hospitals in 2020?

SELECT sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_general WHERE submitting_applicable_manufacturer_or_applicable_gpo_name LIKE 'Pfizer%' AND cast(program_year AS varchar) = '2020'
Which fields of study award the most bachelor's degrees?
Scorecard Most Recent Field Of Study
SELECT cipdesc, sum(try_cast(ipedscount2 AS double)) AS degrees FROM govblock_education.scorecard_most_recent_field_of_study WHERE credlev = '3' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How do published applications divide among the broad technology sectors?

SELECT wipo_sector_title AS sector, count(*) AS applications, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_wipo_technology WHERE wipo_field_sequence = '0' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which counties outside Washington, D.C. send the most workers into the District?

SELECT substr(h_geocode, 1, 5) AS home_county, sum(s000) AS workers FROM govblock_labor.lodes_od WHERE state = 'dc' AND part = 'aux' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2019 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many sections of New York regulations are in the library?
SELECT count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE state = 'ny' AND document_type = 'regulation'
Which political organizations reported the most itemised contributions?
SELECT column03 AS organization, sum(try_cast(column15 AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_nonprofits.pol_org_8872_contributions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many IC50 measurements does ChEMBL hold?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_activities WHERE standard_type = 'IC50'
Which New York City agencies publish the most forms in the collection?
SELECT agency, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_reference.forms WHERE gov = 'NYC' AND agency IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many political action committees are based in Washington, D.C.?
SELECT count(DISTINCT cmte_id) AS committees FROM govblock_fec.committees WHERE cmte_st = 'DC'
Which kinds of relationship connect one Rhea reaction to another?
SELECT type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea_relationships WHERE type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many upheld complaints against auto insurers did New York record for 2023?
New York Auto Insurer Complaint Rankings
SELECT sum(try_cast(upheld_complaints AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_insurance_filings.ny_auto_insurer_complaint_rankings WHERE filing_year = '2023'
Which states have the most hospices listed on Care Compare?
SELECT state, count(DISTINCT cms_certification_number_ccn) AS hospices FROM govblock_health.cc_hospice_provider WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT definition FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_compounds WHERE name = 'caffeine'
Which courts appear most often in judges' job histories?
SELECT organization_name, count(*) AS positions FROM govblock_courts.people_db_positions WHERE coalesce(organization_name, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
When examiners cite earlier patents in rejections, how often is it for obviousness rather than lack of novelty?

SELECT CASE cast(action_type AS varchar) WHEN '102' THEN 'not new (102)' WHEN '103' THEN 'obvious (103)' ELSE cast(action_type AS varchar) END AS ground, count(*) AS citations, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_patents.oa_research_citations GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which kinds of Treasury securities carried the highest average interest rate in September 2025?
SELECT security_desc, try_cast(avg_interest_rate_amt AS double) AS rate FROM govblock_treasury.avg_interest_rates WHERE record_date = '2025-09-30' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What was the median home purchase loan in 2023?

SELECT approx_percentile(try_cast(loan_amount AS double), 0.5) AS median_loan FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1' AND cast(loan_purpose AS varchar) = '1'
Which sections of the U.S. Code are cited most often in state law?

SELECT ref AS usc_title_section, count(*) AS citing_sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined CROSS JOIN UNNEST(CAST(json_parse(cross_references_usc) AS array(varchar))) AS t(ref) WHERE cross_references_usc LIKE '[%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did households in New York pay per kilowatt-hour of electricity on average in 2024?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS cents_per_kwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.PRICE.NY-RES.A' AND period = '2024'
Which licences do arXiv authors choose most often?
SELECT license, count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.arxiv_papers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much do Davis-Bacon determinations add in fringe benefits per hour, on average?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(fringe AS double)), 2) AS avg_fringe FROM govblock_awards.sam_wd_dba_rates WHERE try_cast(fringe AS double) > 0
Which hospitals collect the most completed patient surveys?
SELECT facility_name, max(try_cast(number_of_completed_surveys AS double)) AS surveys FROM govblock_health.cc_hcahps_hospital WHERE facility_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many students were enrolled in U.S. public schools in 2024-25?
SELECT sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total'
Which states have the most power plants on record with the EIA?
SELECT state, count(DISTINCT plant_code) AS plants FROM govblock_energy.eia860_plant_y_sheet_plant GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of mortgage applications were denied for each race of applicant in 2023?

SELECT derived_race, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*), 1) AS pct_denied FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which kinds of emission sources account for the most reported greenhouse gases in 2023?

SELECT s.subpart_category, sum(try_cast(e.co2e_emission AS double)) AS co2e_tons FROM govblock_environment.ghg_facts_subp_ghg_emission AS e JOIN govblock_environment.ghg_dim_subpart AS s ON try_cast(s.subpart_id AS double) = try_cast(e.sub_part_id AS double) WHERE e.year = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many health-based drinking water violations began in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement WHERE is_health_based_ind = 'Y' AND substr(non_compl_per_begin_date, 7, 4) = '2023'
Which states consume the most natural gas?

SELECT substr(series_id, 12, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS billion_btu FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'SEDS.NGTCB.%.A' AND length(series_id) = 15 AND substr(series_id, 12, 2) NOT IN ('US', 'X3', 'X5') AND period = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many FDIC-insured institutions have closed or merged out of existence?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_finance.fdic_institutions WHERE active = '0'
Which dosage forms are most common among listed drug products?
SELECT dosage_form, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_drug_ndc WHERE dosage_form IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the title of patent US-5153197-A?
SELECT patent_number, title, publication_date FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patents WHERE patent_number = 'US-5153197-A'
Which American companies publish the most scientific research?
SELECT display_name, try_cast(works_count AS double) AS works FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_institutions WHERE type = 'company' AND country_code = 'US' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of single audits raise doubt about the organisation continuing as a going concern?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN upper(substr(cast(is_going_concern_included AS varchar), 1, 1)) IN ('Y', 'T') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_executive.fac_general
Which counties' hospitals handled the most discharges in 2016?
SELECT hospital_county, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE discharge_year = '2016' AND hospital_county IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the systematic IUPAC name for vanillin?
SELECT c1 AS iupac_name FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_iupac WHERE c0 = '1183'
Which kinds of air permits are most common among EPA-tracked facilities?
SELECT caa_permit_types, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_echo_exporter WHERE caa_permit_types IS NOT NULL AND caa_permit_types IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many wholesale power contracts did Lakeside Syracuse LLC report?
SELECT count(DISTINCT contract_unique_id) AS contracts FROM govblock_energy.ferceqr_contracts WHERE seller_company_name = 'Lakeside Syracuse LLC'
Which Texas cities have the most hazardous waste sites on EPA's list?
SELECT city_name, count(*) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_facilities WHERE state_code = 'TX' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many certification marks are on file with the trademark office?
SELECT count(*) AS marks FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE cast(cert_mark_in AS varchar) = '1'
Which states generated the most nuclear power in 2024?

SELECT substr(series_id, 14, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'ELEC.GEN.NUC-%-99.A' AND length(series_id) = 20 AND substr(series_id, 14, 2) <> 'US' AND period = '2024' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
